name: Seikishi Mamoru
source:
The story of how Mamoru became a Holy Knight.

Mamoru received a letter from an aristocrat. She wants to meet the Great Hero who defeated the Demon King. She also wants him to think about marrying her.

"But why?" - Mamoru went on a trip to a new continent while having an unpleasant feeling.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ310906.html]DLsite[/url]]
